comment: C ref: do.c dropz() -> hack.c impact_disturbs_zombies(obj, FALSE) -> disturb_buried_zombies(). Debug-mode wishes make a zombifying kobold corpse, drop it, put a pit under it, and fill the pit with a wished boulder too heavy to carry, which buries the corpse with its ZOMBIFY_MON timer. A second wished boulder dropped on the next square weighs over the non-violent threshold and shortens that timer. Seed, clock and character chosen independently.
